quest.title: Once, the Sacred Seat of Judgment
quest.description: In order to uncover a path to the Heart of the Sacred Mountain, it appears you must obtain a permit from the Chamber of Deliberation...

talks.objective: Go to the Chamber of Deliberation to obtain the permit

dialogues.speaker: Awanyu
dialogues.text: "Let us go. We shall see where they have hidden the permit..."

dialogues.speaker: Awanyu
dialogues.text: "It seems they have left it over there... Did they even think to hide it at all?"

dialogues.speaker: Awanyu
dialogues.text: "Still, it seems but an empty shell..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hey, what's with all these Rifthounds? Gah, that means the permit's...

dialogues.speaker: Awanyu
dialogues.text: "Gate security may have been neutralized, allowing them to take advantage of the opening and enter."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—Wait, what do we do, then?

dialogues.speaker: Awanyu
dialogues.text: "No matter. We need only activate the Chamber of Deliberation's repair and purification facilities."

dialogues.speaker: Awanyu
dialogues.text: "They are over there..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A dragon judge... Is it just me, or is that familiar somehow?

dialogues.speaker: Awanyu
dialogues.text: "I fear you imagine quite the different beast."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "There it is, the engraving light that can activate the scale. That is the permit..."

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew, you can see the whole Sacred City from here!

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Indeed, the shadow of a glorious, unhappy past..."

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Wrroh... Rawrr?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "You wish to know the final outcome of that trial? Haha..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Of course, those who called for sacred judgment knew that the master of all light and flame was simply feigning death, but when the true king, only occasionally clear-minded, made an appearance in the flesh..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "The Thirteen Lords and Three Princes, who before could not stop speaking, hastily withdrew their words, and the whole trial descended into farce, and was thus dissolved..."

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrooo...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Later on, the Three Princes would be slain in battle against humanity, while ten of the Thirteen Lords fell when the Sacred City of Tollan collapsed, with one remaining in Chichen Uctokah..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "But one lord survives to the present day..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Though doubtless not in the form that it would have wished to maintain..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Alright. Let us continue into the Heart of the Sacred Mountain. There, all lies buried... including a yearning for the journey's end."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "My duty shall soon be discharged in full... Chosen of Dragons, if only you could have seen this place in its fullest splendor, its truest beauty..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Go, touch the flame-engraved light... Win permission to reach the Sacred Mountain's heart..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Awanyu... Huh, gone again! Paimon was just getting used to using that name.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, the permit to enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain is ours at last...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrroar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The light on this side... It's gone...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Shadow foe threat detected...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Internal safeguard... Auto-repair mode activated...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! Paimon never imagined there'd be these sorts of mechanisms inside a place like this... Those monsters never stood a chance!

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "This place was built to outlast the very eons themselves. Not only does it bristle with defenses, but it is even capable of self-repair..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's so golden and shiny... Paimon wants to touch it!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Haha, it would be best not to... It will not distinguish between 'friend' or 'foe'... It simply consumes everything it touches."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "...A crass and brutal approach. Hmph, the designs these fools came up with..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, we can use it to open the shield covering the permit, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway... Let's find a way to make this thing ascend, shall we?

choices.text: A serious proposal — a rarity from our dear Paimon...

response.speaker: Secret Source Servant
response.text: "Indeed. I, too, did not expect our white herald to have such hidden depths... Such hidden wisdom. A shock, to be sure."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Paimon doesn't get what you're so shocked about.

talks.objective: Watch out for the Phlogiston barrier as it sweeps down

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, that's a wrap — finally! Guess we've got the permit to enter that "Heart of the Sacred Mountain" or whatever now!

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "No. As I said before, this is merely the permit's empty shell..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "A device made from a single scale, bereft of any information concerning its owner, cannot be converted into a permit."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Otherwise, would it not have become some sort of master key, to be used by any old dragon?"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Quickly, bring a dragon of suitable status to the stand!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Where are we supposed to find a dragon... Hey, wait! Does {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} count?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrawr?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Not... at the moment, no."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then what do we do?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Long ago, after the great sovereign entered the Heart of the Sacred Mountain, there were some who had the authority to, yet did not, activate this permit."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Perhaps this conspicuous specimen was placed here for that very purpose..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like you don't like it here.

dialogues.speaker: Awanyu
dialogues.text: "And neither would you, were you ever to have been regarded as a criminal."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "I knew you would arrive, and so I prepared a welcome of suitable pomp and circumstance..."

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Though I know that you are only being polite, I am indeed glad to see you."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, so it's you after all! So, uh, what are you calling yourself this time?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "This time, my name belonged to a scribe from the Chamber of Deliberation. In truth, he rarely ever touched quill or ink himself — not since the Secret Source Servants were invented, anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Awanyu... You may address me so."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright then, Awanyu. So, are you here to help us out with this "Sacred Mountain Heart Permit" thing?

dialogues.speaker: Awanyu
dialogues.text: "If you are without it, the Astral Assemblages within the Heart of the Sacred Mountain will attack upon detecting any unauthorized entry..."

dialogues.speaker: Awanyu
dialogues.text: "...I have extracted records from 'Awanyu.' According to them, the permit required to enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain has been placed above the Chamber of Deliberation."

dialogues.speaker: Awanyu
dialogues.text: "For that cause, I have no choice but to set foot in this place... This congress of arrogant fools, this assembly of those who gloried in their powerlessness."

dialogues.speaker: Awanyu
dialogues.text: "Not to mention a den of pretenders claiming the right to judge their own kin..."
